meta.note: Targets for a from-scratch run (`python fuseaip/scripts/run_all.py`). AUROC on test1.csv (817 rows, 262 positives), folds = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) over train1.csv in file order. The three ML views are deterministic given the code + data + seed and are checked to 1e-3 against the values measured on the release machine; the two deep views involve SGD, so they get ranges instead of point values. Fusion ranges are generous on purpose: the weights are re-derived from OOF every run.

hand.note: single ExtraTrees seed 0 (the earlier 3-seed average gave 0.7825).

tlora.note: TEMPORARY band, to be tightened after the first full run on the target machine. Anchors from earlier runs (same train1 rows, official folds.csv, same hyperparameters): an independent implementation scored per-fold 0.7559/0.7954/0.6799/0.8092/0.7834 -> 0.7919 when its five test-probability vectors are averaged; this package's own full run under the old fold column gave 0.7719; the earlier release's frozen delta weights score 0.7957 on these 817 rows. Fold-to-fold spread is ~0.03 and the 5-fold average moves ~0.02 between runs, so the band's job is to catch a broken implementation (0.70 or 0.88), not to pin a seed. The historical 0.8268 headline came from a StratifiedKFold re-split of the pooled data and never reported per-fold scores on these 817 rows.
